reviewedDimensions: NLE export and import media correctness
self-contained bundle authorization and publication safety

findings.problem: NLE exchange validated a declared source SHA but did not bind the whole export to one stable Timeline/source snapshot or reject EDL ranges beyond the real media duration.
findings.resolution: Centralize current-source verification, real-duration bounds and before/after identity checks; bind the verified source identity into export reports.

findings.problem: NLE import could retain an orphan candidate when report creation failed and moving a candidate to another directory broke relative inputs or reused output/stem paths.
findings.resolution: Rebase Timeline inputs, isolate candidate outputs/stems, validate the written candidate, and remove only the invocation-owned matching-SHA candidate on failure.

findings.problem: A delivery profile was marked available after checking only its video encoder.
findings.resolution: Require video encoder, audio encoder, muxer and pixel format; expose per-requirement evidence and refresh the runtime probe when a plan is created.

findings.problem: Any non-empty license/provenance label other than exact unknown/unverified could authorize media inclusion, including pending or restricted labels.
findings.resolution: Use explicit license and provenance vocabularies with evidence, retain documented project-generated kinds, and fail closed for pending-review, fair-use-review, restricted and arbitrary states.

findings.problem: The bundle's final directory rename could replace a concurrently created empty destination directory.
findings.resolution: Reserve the destination exclusively, move invocation-owned entries only, publish manifest last, and use token-scoped cleanup without deleting foreign content.

findings.problem: Loading a 64-version Workspace rehashed the same large source media once per Timeline.
findings.resolution: Share current-source verification by canonical source path within one Workspace load, then recheck each unique source at the whole-view boundary.

findings.problem: Projection, Workspace, bundle and delivery-plan paths could combine content read before a concurrent change with identities read after it.
findings.resolution: Bind initial identities, verify after reads/builds and again at publication boundaries; return the bound identity instead of a late unrelated readback.

findings.problem: The mobile capability map expanded the document to more than four thousand pixels and displaced Program and Timeline from the editing context.
findings.resolution: Make mobile drawers viewport-bounded internal scrollers with a sticky heading and add a 390x844 drawer-height browser assertion.

findings.problem: The delivery selector could retain a blocked first option when another runtime profile was available, or leave submit enabled when none were available.
findings.resolution: Select the first available profile and disable plan submission when the runtime exposes no complete profile.

findings.problem: Legacy NLE and Studio fixtures declared EDL ranges beyond fake or shorter source files, so old tests could pass without proving media correctness.
findings.resolution: Replace affected fixtures with decodable media of the declared duration and keep out-of-range cases as explicit negative regressions.

claimBoundary: All producer-reproducible R3 findings are closed locally. This is not independent final-review evidence and does not prove creator acceptance, final rendered-media quality, target NLE import, remote CI, commit, push or deployment.
